homograph.note: A learner who knows the noun (the building material) will not guess the adjective "the opposite of abstract", and vice versa, even though the two share an etymology. Only the adjective was tested, so the card should show the two senses as separate blocks and a hint must say which one it targets.

senses.definition: based on real things that can be seen or touched, rather than on general ideas; definite and specific

examples.en: The committee wanted concrete proposals, not vague talk about reform.
examples.fa: کمیته پیشنهادهای عینی می‌خواست، نه حرف‌های مبهم درباره‌ی اصلاحات.

senses.definition: a hard building material made by mixing cement, sand, small stones and water

examples.en: The workers poured concrete into the wooden frames of the bridge.
examples.fa: کارگران بتن را در قالب‌های چوبی پل ریختند.
